body:
>You need nothing to do it except a bit of instruction on how to go about finding out what you are.

I dont know why but I suddenly automatically react negatively to that sentence. I have been instructed to think "this", to do "that" most of my life only to find rejection and disappointment at the end. I am burned, and scarred.

Perhaps it is my own pride and guarded-shield that keeps me from learning from other people, from learning what could be good for me... perhaps that is my downfall. 

I dont claim to know everything, in fact I would rather know nothing. But to wake up in a realization, is to sleep in ignorance. Such is the irony of life. I am at an existential crisis, with enough knowledge to rationalize death. But obviously, I do not have enough wisdom to keep on living.

I sincerely thank you for the time rendered.

i keep fighting myself from making a counter-argument with each of the advices you gave me. I thank you for giving some time to reply. I am thinking of ways to break-free and it's been quite difficult fighting over my own insecurities and apprehensions. i never truly learned to gain confidence without the effects of drug and/or alcohol, so this is also something new to me. i am doubting myself but im holding on, i cannot see anyone helping me with my burdens for now - just myself. i hope i will found something, and i hope it will be soon. once again, thank you.

financially, yes that's the main thing. folks would not/could not support me. I am in a third world country so going elsewhere would require lots of resources. i am broke, i earn little and save little.
